servo: Feetech STS3215 (model 777, firmware 3), 3 axes on one bus, ballbal

model.description: goal -> dead time -> trapezoid (accel/decel/v_max, re-planned per goal) -> first-order lag

mapping: Rig values (min/max/home/rest, speed, acceleration) are merged from profiles/platform-v2/rig.toml and calibration.toml by src/ballbal/simulation/profile.py; nothing about the rig is duplicated here. sim joint angle = (counts - zero) * 360/4096 deg with zero = rest_position - cad_lower_link_base_contact_deg * 4096/360: rest_position is the rig seated on the base (`ballbal rest`), which is the CAD contact angle. sim_joints: rig servo id -> sim joint (IDs run clockwise from above).
